tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
ASUS PRIME B760M-AYW WIFI 12th/13th/14th GEN ATX MOTHERBOARD

The ASUS B760M-AYW WIFI Micro-ATX Motherboard is designed to deliver powerful performance for Intel's 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors. This motherboard supports DDR5 memory, PCIe 4.0, and features Wi-Fi 6 for fast and reliable wireless connectivity. With a compact Micro-ATX form factor, it's perfect for building high-performance systems in smaller spaces. Whether you're creating a gaming and content creation setup, or a general-purpose PC, the ASUS B760M-AYW WIFI offers top-tier features for a smooth and efficient computing experience.

  • Supports Intel 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen CPUs for outstanding performance
  • DDR5 support for high-speed memory and better overall system efficiency
  • Wi-Fi 6 for faster, more stable wireless connectivity
  • PCIe 4.0 slots for faster data transfer speeds and improved performance
  • Micro-ATX form factor ideal for compact, high-performance PC builds
